title: The canonical structures of the limit of the Yang-Mills flows for nef and big classes
summary: In the previous paper \cite{Jin26}, the author introduced the notions of an adapted current $T$ and an adapted Hermitian-Einstein metric to establish the Kobayashi-Hitchin correspondence for a nef and big class $α$. As a continuation of the previous work, this paper studies the solvability and the convergence of the Yang-Mills flow for a nef and big class $α$ on a holomorphic vector bundle $E$ over a compact Kähler manifold $X$. In particular, we show that the limit of the Yang-Mills flow at infinity is determined by the holomorphic structure of $E$ and the nef and big class $α$. More…
